privacy.sec1Body: This Privacy Policy explains how Zyvexo collects, uses, stores and protects your data when you use our AI music creation service. By accessing or using the platform you confirm that you have read and understood this policy.
privacy.sec2Lead: We only collect what is necessary to run the service, and only when you provide it or it arises from your use:
privacy.sec2i1: Account information – the email address you register with, an optional username, and the age value, which is used solely to enforce the minimum-age requirement.
privacy.sec2i2: Creation content – the prompts, lyrics and project data you submit, and the audio files generated from them.
privacy.sec2i3: Technical and log data – device and browser information, IP address and usage logs, used for troubleshooting, security and service improvement.
privacy.sec2neg1: Payment card or bank account details – paid credit purchases are not available on Zyvexo yet, so no payment data is processed.
privacy.sec3Lead: Your data is used only for the following purposes:
privacy.sec3i1: Providing, maintaining and improving the service.
privacy.sec3i2: Running the music generations and audio tools you request.
privacy.sec3i3: Enforcing usage limits and preventing abuse, fraud and technical failures.
privacy.sec3i4: Diagnosing errors and protecting security, and complying with legal obligations.
privacy.sec4Body: Account and project records are stored in a PostgreSQL database we administer; audio files are stored in a private object-storage bucket; playback links we hand out are short-lived signed URLs that expire automatically. Usage counters roll over daily and monthly.
privacy.sec4i1: When you delete a task or work in My Creations, its audio files and related records are deleted as well.
privacy.sec4i2: Data that is no longer needed is deleted or anonymised, and we handle deletion requests within the limits of applicable law.
privacy.sec4i3: Our error-monitoring provider may retain diagnostic data for a limited period.
privacy.sec5Lead: We do not sell your personal data. To deliver the service we must pass the necessary data to:
privacy.sec5i1: Third-party AI music generation and model-hosting providers, which receive only the prompts, lyrics or audio needed to produce the result you asked for.
privacy.sec5i2: Infrastructure, hosting, storage and error-monitoring providers that operate the platform on our behalf.
privacy.sec5i3: Authorities, where required by law or a valid legal request; or a successor in a merger or asset transfer, which remains bound by this policy.
privacy.sec6Lead: Subject to applicable data protection law, you can:
privacy.sec6i1: Access the data we hold about you and obtain a copy of it.
privacy.sec6i2: Have inaccurate data corrected, and have your data or works deleted where the law allows.
privacy.sec6i3: Withdraw consent to processing, or object to or restrict particular processing.
privacy.sec6i4: Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.sec7Body: Traffic between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit, and every task, download link and work is checked against your signed-in account so that others cannot read it. Keys are held only server-side, under least privilege. No method of transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be absolutely secure.
privacy.sec8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version is always published on this page, and material changes will be announced in the product or by another appropriate means before they take effect.
privacy.sec9Body: If you have a question, request or complaint about this Privacy Policy or about your personal data, you can reach us by email:
privacy.footerNote: Continuing to use Zyvexo after an update means you accept the current version of this Privacy Policy.
